name: setlist-maker
description: Printable band setlists with keys, tempos, set times and a CSV.

interface.longDescription:
Make a printable setlist for your band's next gig from a pasted song list, with set times and a CSV. Zovo Setlist Maker is a setlist maker for cover bands, wedding bands, worship teams and singer-songwriters.

Paste the list the way you keep it: a numbered list, "Song - Key - BPM - Time", rows copied from a spreadsheet with a header, or one line such as "Valerie Eb 3:40, Crazy C 2:58". Lines like SET 2, Set break, --- or Encore start a new set, and "->" after a song marks a segue into the next one. You can also ask it to split one list into 2 or 3 sets of similar length, or to start a new set after 45 minutes.

The PDF has stage pages in large type, one per set, sized to fill the page so the list is readable from the floor, with the key and capo on the right. A band copy table lists each song with key, transposition, BPM, time and cues, with the time of each set. Set times and the show total are added up in minutes and seconds from the times you give, with an optional changeover gap between songs (none after a segue). Songs without a time are listed and left out of the total, not guessed.

New singer or a different tuning? Shift one song or the whole set by semitones or to a named key. Each song shows the key to play in (for example G -> A (+2)), and with a capo it shows the chord shapes to play (A with capo 2: G shapes).

Download the PDF on US Letter or A4 and a CSV for your spreadsheet.

Limitations: up to 80 songs and 6 sets; keys are Western major and minor keys (other key text prints as given); it does not look up keys, tempos or song lengths, and makes no chord charts or lyrics; the PDF prints Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are left out of the PDF, the CSV keeps them).
defaultPrompt: Make a setlist: Valerie Eb 3:40, Crazy C 2:58, Jolene C#m 2:42, then Encore: Shout 4:10
Split into 2 sets: Dreams 4:17, Rhiannon 3:45, Sara 4:42, Gypsy 4:24, Landslide 3:19, Little Lies 3:38
Setlist with all songs 2 semitones lower: Valerie Eb 3:40, Crazy C 2:58, Jolene C#m 2:42

positive.prompt: Make a setlist for The Late Shift: Valerie Eb 3:40, Crazy C 2:58, Jolene C#m 2:42, Superstition Ebm 4:05, then Encore: Shout 4:10
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_setlist once with the 5 songs and an Encore break. The reply says 2 sets: Set 1 has 4 songs and runs 13:25, the Encore runs 4:10, the show total is 17:35, and gives the PDF and CSV links.

positive.description: Split one list into two sets
positive.prompt: Split into 2 sets of similar length: Dreams 4:17, Rhiannon 3:45, Go Your Own Way 3:38, Landslide 3:19, Everywhere 3:46, Little Lies 3:38, Sara 4:42, Gypsy 4:24
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_setlist once with 8 songs and split_sets 2. The reply keeps the order: Set 1 has 4 songs and runs 14:59, Set 2 has 4 songs and runs 16:30, total 31:29, with PDF and CSV links.

positive.prompt: Stage setlist with all songs 2 semitones lower: Valerie Eb 3:40, Crazy C 2:58, Jolene C#m 2:42 with capo 2
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_setlist once with transpose_all -2. The reply says Valerie Eb -> Db (-2), Crazy C -> Bb (-2), Jolene C#m -> Bm (-2) with capo 2: Am shapes, total 9:20, and gives the PDF link.

positive.description: Pasted spreadsheet rows with changeover time
positive.prompt:
Make a setlist from this, 30 seconds between songs:
Song,Key,BPM,Time
Mr. Brightside,D,148,3:42
Wonderwall,F#m,87,4:18
Zombie,Em,84,5:06
Hey Jude,F,74,7:11
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_setlist once with the 4 songs (or the pasted text) and changeover_seconds 30. The reply gives 4 songs with keys and BPM and a total of 21:47 including 30 s changeover between songs.

positive.description: Numbered list with a segue and a missing time
positive.prompt:
Print this setlist:
1. Sympathy for the Devil (E) 6:18 ->
2. Gimme Shelter (C#m) 4:31
3. Paint It Black (Em)
SET 2
4. Satisfaction (E) 3:44
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_setlist once. The reply says Set 1 runs 10:49 without Paint It Black, which has no duration, Set 2 runs 3:44, the total is 14:33 and excludes 1 song without a duration; Sympathy for the Devil segues into Gimme Shelter.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: printable setlists from a pasted song list, stage pages in large type, band copy table, set and show totals, transposition and capo notes, PDF and CSV.

pl-PL.subtitle: Setlisty dla zespołu do druku
pl-PL.description: Setlista do wydruku na koncert z wklejonej listy utworów, z czasami setów i plikiem CSV. Wklej numerowaną listę, wiersze „Utwór - Tonacja - BPM - Czas” albo wiersze z arkusza. Linie SET 2, Encore lub --- zaczynają nowy set, a „->” oznacza przejście do następnego utworu. Strony sceniczne dużą czcionką, jedna na set, z tonacją i kapodastrem, oraz tabela dla zespołu z tonacją, transpozycją, BPM, czasem i uwagami. Czas setów i całego koncertu jest sumowany z podanych czasów; utwory bez czasu są wymienione, a nie zgadywane. Transpozycja jednego utworu lub całego setu. PDF w formacie Letter lub A4 oraz CSV. Do 80 utworów i 6 setów.

de-DE.subtitle: Setlisten für die Band
de-DE.description: Eine druckbare Setlist für den nächsten Auftritt aus einer eingefügten Songliste, mit Setzeiten und CSV. Füge eine nummerierte Liste, Zeilen wie „Song - Tonart - BPM - Zeit“ oder Zeilen aus einer Tabelle ein. Zeilen wie SET 2, Encore oder --- beginnen ein neues Set, „->“ markiert einen Übergang in den nächsten Song. Bühnenseiten in großer Schrift, eine pro Set, mit Tonart und Kapo, dazu eine Bandkopie mit Tonart, Transposition, BPM, Zeit und Hinweisen. Set- und Gesamtzeiten werden aus deinen Zeiten addiert; Songs ohne Zeit werden genannt und nicht geschätzt. Transponiere einen Song oder das ganze Set. PDF in Letter oder A4 und CSV. Bis zu 80 Songs und 6 Sets.

es-ES.subtitle: Setlists para tu banda
es-ES.description: Un setlist para imprimir para tu próximo concierto a partir de una lista de canciones pegada, con tiempos de cada set y un CSV. Pega una lista numerada, líneas como «Canción - Tono - BPM - Tiempo» o filas de una hoja de cálculo. Las líneas SET 2, Encore o --- empiezan un set nuevo y «->» marca el paso directo a la siguiente canción. Páginas de escenario con letra grande, una por set, con tono y cejilla, y una tabla para la banda con tono, transposición, BPM, tiempo y notas. Los tiempos se suman a partir de los que das; las canciones sin tiempo se indican y no se adivinan. Transporta una canción o todo el set. PDF en Carta o A4 y CSV. Hasta 80 canciones y 6 sets.

fr-FR.subtitle: Setlists pour votre groupe
fr-FR.description: Une setlist à imprimer pour votre prochain concert à partir d'une liste de morceaux collée, avec la durée de chaque set et un CSV. Collez une liste numérotée, des lignes « Titre - Tonalité - BPM - Durée » ou des lignes d'un tableur. Les lignes SET 2, Rappel/Encore ou --- commencent un nouveau set et « -> » marque l'enchaînement avec le morceau suivant. Pages de scène en gros caractères, une par set, avec tonalité et capodastre, et un tableau pour le groupe avec tonalité, transposition, BPM, durée et notes. Les durées sont additionnées à partir des vôtres ; les morceaux sans durée sont signalés, pas devinés. Transposez un morceau ou tout le set. PDF en Letter ou A4 et CSV. Jusqu'à 80 morceaux et 6 sets.

ja-JP.subtitle: バンド用セットリストを印刷
ja-JP.description: 貼り付けた曲リストから、次のライブ用の印刷できるセットリストを作ります。各セットの時間とCSV付きです。番号付きリスト、「曲名 - キー - BPM - 時間」の行、表計算ソフトからコピーした行をそのまま貼り付けられます。SET 2、Encore、--- の行で新しいセットが始まり、「->」は次の曲へのつなぎを表します。ステージ用ページは大きな文字で1セット1ページ、キーとカポ付き。バンド用の表にはキー、移調、BPM、時間、メモが並びます。セット時間と合計は入力した時間から計算し、時間のない曲は推測せずに一覧で示します。1曲だけ、またはセット全体を移調できます。PDF(レターまたはA4)とCSV。最大80曲、6セット。PDFに日本語の文字は印刷されません(CSVには残ります)。

pt-BR.subtitle: Setlists para sua banda
pt-BR.description: Um setlist para imprimir para o próximo show a partir de uma lista de músicas colada, com o tempo de cada set e um CSV. Cole uma lista numerada, linhas como “Música - Tom - BPM - Tempo” ou linhas de uma planilha. Linhas SET 2, Encore ou --- começam um novo set e “->” marca a emenda com a próxima música. Páginas de palco em letra grande, uma por set, com tom e capotraste, e uma tabela para a banda com tom, transposição, BPM, tempo e observações. Os tempos são somados a partir dos que você informa; músicas sem tempo são listadas e não estimadas. Transponha uma música ou o set inteiro. PDF em Carta ou A4 e CSV. Até 80 músicas e 6 sets.
